newsitem.title: USA: Midwest grain dealers report corn, soy protection.
newsitem.headline: Midwest grain dealers report corn, soy protection.

text.p: Cash grain dealers in Iowa and Illinois reported scattered protection on spot cash grain bids on Monday of two cents a bushel on corn and five cents on soybeans on expectations of a lower futures opening.
Heavy rains at the weekend and on Monday in eastern Iowa, northern Missouri and Illinois should help late soybeans and corn, dealers said.
Movement was not heavy but it had picked up, they added.
Dealers working off CBOT Project A posted no protection but December corn was down 3/4 cent and November soybeans down 4-1/2 cents overnight, they noted.
